Pracaṇḍakṛṣṇasahasranāmāvali
See Kṛṣṇasahasranāmāvali, Adyar I. p. 221b. Adyar D. IV. 2159.

Pracaṇḍagaruḍa
or Vinatānanda. vyāyoga. by Govindaśeṣa, son of Śeṣa Yajñeśvara. BL. 275. Ujjain Latest Additions 146. See Vinatānanda below.

Pracaṇḍacaṇḍikāsahasranāma
SB. New D.. V. 1. 20836.

Pracaṇḍacaṇḍikāsahasranāmastotra
from Viśvasāratantra. Bik. 1304. Sk. Ray D.. 186.

Pracaṇḍacaṇḍikāstotra
Varendra 467C.

Pracaṇḍadeva
--Svayambhūcaityapañcabuddhastotra from Svāyambhuvapurāṇa. IO. 6819 (b).

Pracaṇḍapāṇḍava
or Bālabhārata. nāṭaka by Rājaśekhara. H. 98. IO. 7382. K. 72. Oxf. 140a. Oxf. II. 1247 (8). Peters. I. p. 117 (no. 118) (inc.). See under Bālabhārata.

Pracaṇḍabhairava
śai. Q. in Janmamaraṇavicāra, Kas. Texts. 19. p. 23.

Pracaṇḍabhairava
vyāyoga. on the fight between Hiraṇyagarbha an. Puṇḍarīka. by Sadāśiva, a Naiyāyika. Burnell 169a. TD. 4645.

Pracaṇḍabhairavadigbandhana
mantra. MD. 6634.

Pracaṇḍamahāvīrasūryanārāyaṇa_(?)
TA. 1395/3.

Pracaṇḍamādhava
poet. See Caṇḍamādhava, NCC. VI. p. 294b an. Mādhava below. [Page227-b]

Pracaṇḍarāhūdaya
a. allegorical drama in 5 acts an. C. by Ghanaśyāma.
Pt.. with his gloss on the basis of a single ms. Belgaum, 1960.
--C. Hz. 1675. TD. 4388. (fr. of Ghanaśyāma's C..
--C. Vṛṣāvalī by a.'s elder brother Īśa; ref. to by Ghanaśyāma in his C. See Intro. verses of C. in the ptd. text.

Pracaladāsa
mistake for Acala(dāsa). See under Acala, NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 68b.

Pracalasiṃha
mistake for Acalasim3ha. Same a. Acala.

Pracuraṇastavanastuti(che)
Jain. BP. p. 162a.

Pracūrṇagāthāsaṃcaya
Jain. BP. p. 223a.

Pracetas
writer on dh.
Enumerated a. one among the sages by Parāśara; q. a. authority on śrāddha, āśauca an. prāyaścitta by Medhātithi in C. on Manusmṛti; Haradatta in C. on Gautamadh. sū.; Vijñāneśvara in C. on Yājñavalkyasmṛti; Hemādri an. Devaṇabhaṭṭa. See Kane, HDS. I. p. 229; ref. to by Vāsudeva Sārasvatottama in Nirṇayasāra, RASB. III. 2120; by Śūlapāṇī in Vratakālaviveka, RASB. III. 2124.

Pracetaḥ_Smṛti
dh. ascribed to Pracetas. Kavīndrācārya 595.
--C. Ibid.
C.. previous entry.
--Bṛhatpracetas. Q. frequently by Haradatta in C. on Gautamadh. sū.; by Aparārka an. Vijñāneśvara in C.s on Yājñavalkyasmṛti on āśauca an. prāyaścitta.
See Kane, HDS. I. p. 229.
--Vṛddhapracetas. Q. by Aparārka an. Vijñāneśvara in C.s on Yājñavalkyasmṛti [Page228-a. on the same topics; by Hemādri an. in Madanapārijāta.
See Kane, Ibid.

Pracetāyana
ancient writer on Anuprāsika. ref. to by Siṅgabhūpāla in Rasārṇavasudhākara. See Poona Ori. XXIV. pts. 3 an. 4. p. 158; by Rājaśekhara in Kāvyamīmām3sā p. 1.
See Kane, HSP. p. 425a.

Pracchannabrahmavādanirākaraṇa
vedānta. by Veṅkaṭācārya, son of Aṇṇayārya of Surapuram. Rice 154.

Prācaḥ
ancient poets. q. in Vidyākarasahasraka verses 687. 904. 906.

Prācīnakathā
Jaṭāśaṅkar 83.

Prācīnagurupraṇālī
AS. p. 113 (along with Caitanyadhyāna).

Prācīnagauḍa
--Sam3vatsarapradīpa.
Q. by Puruṣottama in Avatāravādāvalī, Oxf. 38b.

Prācīnajātaka
Kāmakotī 12/15.

Prācīnajainalekhasaṅgraha

Prācīnajainasmāraka
itihāsa. by Śītalaprasāda. Pannalal Bombay IV. p. 15 (parts I & II). (ptd.).

Prācīnajainetihāsa

Prācīnatarka
ny. Viśvabhāratī. 2921 (fr.).

Prācīnadigambara
by Tātyā Nemināthapāṅgala. Arrah I. A. p. 19 (ptd.).

Prācīnapadyāvalī

Prācīnaprāyaścittaviveka
dh. q. by Raghunandana in Śuddhitattva sn. of his Smṛtitattva, Serampore edn. II. 201.

Prācīnabhārata
Jain. Śvet. itihāsa. by Harimaṅgala Miśra. Pannalal Bombay V. p. 18.

Prācīnamuktivāda
ny. SSPC. III. K. 124.

Prācīnayogya
one of the recensions of Sv. listed in the Caraṇavyūha, TD. 1763.

Prācīnarājetihāsa
on the dynasties of later kings. Compiled from Viṣṇupurāṇa an. other works. SB. New D.. IV. 16225.

Prācīnalekhamaṇimālā
Arrah I. A. p. 18 (ptd.) (p.. 2).

Prācīnalekhamālā
collection of ancient historical records in three vols. Kāvyamālā nos. 34. 65. 80. N. S. Press, Bombay, 1892. 1897. 1903.

Prācīnaśaṅkaravijaya
by Anantānandagiri.
See Śaṅkaravijaya below.

Prācīnaśālāśrati
Sv. cited by Ānandatīrtha in Gītābhāṣya. See BNK. Sarma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. I. p. 355.

Prācīnaśrāddhaviveka
dh. q. by Raghunandana in Śrāddhatattva (p. 200) sn. of his Smṛtitattva. [Page145-a.
See Poona Ori. XXI. p. 88.
